SELECT event_id, status, payload FROM outbox
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM bookings WHERE status = 'confirmed'

SELECT b.booking_id, COUNT(DISTINCT h.hold_id) as holds, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_id) as charges FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY b.booking_id
SELECT * FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('holds', 'charges')

SELECT b.booking_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.state = 'captured' THEN 1 END) as captured_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id = b.booking_id) as has_hold FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING captured_charges != 1 OR has_hold != 1

SELECT b.booking_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.booking_id = b.booking_id) as checkin_count FROM bookings b WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.booking_id = b.booking_id) != 1
SELECT c.charge_id FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON c.booking_id = b.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL
